canonical_text: Inline and pop-up editors MUST visibly identify the source document and whether edits affect the original. Pop-ups require a title, Close, Open in owning app and permission/save state, plus Back or breadcrumbs when navigating within a nested container. Closing returns focus and the surrounding view to the originating item. Escape closes the innermost dismissible surface, not an unrelated outer editor; modal surfaces use the shared focus/inert contract. Dismissal MUST NOT discard uncommitted edits. Where a full-screen mobile view replaces a desktop pop-up, Back returns to the same contextual location.
